{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter out refunded orders (they don't contribute to valid conversion stats)
converted_orders = real_orders[real_orders['converted'] == 1]

# Now, filter out rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_converters = converted_orders[converted_orders['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of customers who converted
mean_age = valid_converters['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Mean age of customers who converted: {mean_age}')"}
